disclosure: Designed after these two convenience examples. Not externally preregistered. No panel outcome has been loaded.
source_snapshot: Archive as downloaded now, with SHA256 and retrieval date; not claimed to be the exact historical public vintage.
access_gate: One further permitted public access attempt, at most 30 minutes of active work. If unavailable, report data-insufficient; no proxies, identity disguise or access-control bypass; no search-selected issuer panel substitution.

sample.primary_unit: unique nonempty EDGAR series ID, reference date, USD currency entry
sample.coverage: Batch-defined universe, not all US bond funds and not all March 2025 filings. No private classification required. Do not duplicate share classes.
sample.deduplication: Among records in this batch with the same series and reference date, select the latest filing accepted by cutoff; tie by accession number. Preserve earlier originals/amendments in an audit table. Do not splice metric fields across versions.
sample.inclusion: Positive NAV; both metrics and all five nodes present as finite decimals; exactly one unambiguous USD entry. Missing is not zero.
sample.exclusions: Missing series ID, conflicting duplicate currency rows, inconsistent reference date, absent/nonfinite fields, incompatible known units; list every reason and count. No positive-NAV threshold beyond zero. Do not select by fund name, exposure size or outcome.
sample.no_silent_repair: No winsorization, guessed unit conversion, sign flipping, class summing, epsilon denominators or missing-to-zero fill. All-zero vectors retained and separately counted. Unresolved rows remain quarantined.

metrics.relative_node_residual: abs(residual)/(100*abs(DV01)); undefined if DV01=0, including zero/zero
metrics.secondary: sum of absolute node residuals/NAV*10000, explicitly only a vector discrepancy; not a parallel-shock loss
metrics.display_precision: Record source decimals. A half-unit-in-last-displayed-place bound is conditional on rounding at that precision; padded zeros and internal model precision are unknown. Do not claim discrepancies below/above this bound prove anything about model correctness.
metrics.reporting: Counts, unweighted median/p90/max, and NAV-weighted distribution on the same eligible sample; no population inference or causal claim. Report 1, 10 and 100 NAV-bp thresholds together without choosing the most favorable.

source_reconciliation.development_examples: Exclude from confirmatory language; neither matches the fixed primary reference date.
source_reconciliation.selection: For an initial source audit, inspect the first 20 eligible series in lexicographic series-ID order, the 20 largest primary statistics, and all ties at the 20th value; preserve overlapping membership. This audit selection is not a representative sample.
source_reconciliation.required: Check accession, date, NAV, currency, all node pairs, amendments and Part E explanations against original filings; document shock direction, scaling and convention evidence. If conventions cannot be resolved, classify arithmetic only; no true-convexity or underreported-loss inference.
source_reconciliation.replication: Reproduce primary statistics from the raw fields using independent rational arithmetic on the audited set. Check NAV=assets-liabilities within documented filing precision; quarantine unreconciled discrepancies.

gates.scale_gate: At least 100 eligible series in the fixed batch to justify a scalable panel exercise; this is an operational threshold, not a power calculation. Do not append another quarter if it fails.
gates.materiality_gate: At least 5 source-reconciled funds from at least 3 registrants with maximum node discrepancy >10 NAV bp, and documented comparable units/conventions. These are researcher-chosen triage thresholds, not regulatory or welfare benchmarks. Failure ends the material-discrepancy lane; do not search alternative cutoffs.
gates.causal_gate: No causal estimand in this pilot.
gates.economic_interpretation_gate: Even passing the materiality screen supports only a disclosed-scaling result. Independently justified matched portfolio revaluation, shock convention, and uncertainty bounds are required before interpreting a discrepancy as approximation error or economic exposure; fund-wide changes are not derivative margin calls.
gates.priority_gate: Read the latest freely accessible full Hidden Duration manuscript and targeted literature on N-PORT reporting quality/rate sensitivity. State an incremental question and contribution relative to prior work. Until then, keep the effort a replication/measurement pilot; no novelty confirmation.
gates.long_campaign: Do not start unless acquisition, scale, measurement, economic interpretation and priority gates pass. New holdout/design must be frozen separately before testing predictive or stress-screening claims.

forbidden_inferences: a fully public replication of Lipper/CRSP/Morningstar-dependent studies
real-time predictive performance from a current historical archive
sum of nonlinear node shocks equals a joint shock
